reviews.author: Ashley Jang
reviews.text:
It's a place I've been meaning to visit for several years, and I ended up going this strawberry season.
The cafe wasn't as big as I thought, but since it was on the first floor, the view of Dongdaemun through the large windows was impressive, and you can see that they took care to keep the strawberry concept, such as pink table napkins, without being excessive.
Although there wasn't a wide variety of desserts, they were decorated beautifully and were delicious so I wanted to try at least one of each type.
I was fortunate that the fresh strawberries were fresher and sweeter than I expected, and there were also hot foods (pasta, cream shrimp, perilla oil buckwheat noodles, etc.) to give my mouth a break between the sweet desserts, so eating them in turns made it more enjoyable.
After eating the onion soup served in the middle, I felt like my stomach was relieved a bit.
It was a pleasant experience for the eyes, and I regret that I would have been able to enjoy the dessert less greasy if there had been at least one spicy food such as tteokbokki.

reviews.author: Artist Kim
reviews.text:
I knew I couldn't go without a reservation, so I made a reservation through Naver and went.

Composition is based on 2 people.
2 welcome drinks (choose one from mango ade, mango latte, or mango cocktail)
refreshments
2 cups of coffee or tea of your choice
mango shaved ice
cold pasta

It came out like this, but because it was the weekend and there were a lot of people, the service came out a little late.

After I finished my afternoon tea, tea came out... haha
It's a shame I left out so late

The cold pasta was surprisingly delicious.
The mango shaved ice was really good too.

Afternoon tea is usually expensive.
It has more composition than other places.
Personally, I was satisfied

reviews.author: WANGYOUNG LEE
reviews.text:
Although this place is on the 1st floor, it is an excellent location embracing Dongdaemun. There was an entrance door between the hotel lobby and the lounge, so the movement lines with check-in customers did not overlap, so it looked good.

It's strawberry season and Barbie doll season. Was it because more than 200 teams had already visited so it was a passport cover? There was no information about whether the free gift was sold out or not. But today was a weekday, so I was the only customer enjoying the afternoon tea.

First of all, the visuals are superb. The lounge is also mapped to Barbie, and the strawberry-flavored sweets and strawberry drinks provided as standard are enough to fill you with excitement. And even Heunginjimun~

However, scones, the flower of afternoon tea, are included and omitted with croissants. The savory is weak and all the sweets taste the same. The strawberry drinks are also sweet, so something doesn't go well with them.

The staff were friendly and explained things well. They said next was mango season, so I saw the official sign for a long time, and I saw kiwis and mangoes.

Most afternoon teas seem to be themed according to the season, such as strawberry, mango, chocolate, chestnuts, etc. I hope there will be more delicious things next season.

There are three pubs from the 90s gathered in Changsin-dong.
Rainbow Hope, Bally Hope, Bronx Hope

Rainbow Hope is the smallest, but it is a great snack restaurant. It's not even a chicken restaurant, but there's a local resident who serves fried whole chicken.

reviews.author: Kwak Do-yeon
reviews.text:
It’s inside an alley, so “Is there a restaurant here?” I thought this was a place where the atmosphere completely changes the moment you open the door. Thanks to the warm lighting and cozy space, I was able to enjoy my meal while feeling the right emotions.

You can freely choose your wine by the glass/bottle, and the system of choosing the wine glass you want is fun. Not only wine, but also soju, beer, and non-alcoholic drinks are available, so it's a place where you don't have to worry if you come with someone who doesn't drink alcohol. There was also a snack bar where you could eat light snacks, so it was nice to have a light meal.

I had beef pork ragu tteokbokki and white wine, and the combination was really good. The slightly spicy ragu sauce had a rich meat flavor, and the long, noodle-like rice cake made it fun to eat. The white wine was refreshing and neutral, so it went well with the food, and they gave me a chilling bag so I could drink it until the end.

The menu has a variety of pasta, risotto, etc., so I definitely want to visit again next time to try other dishes. Recommended to those looking for a wine bar in Dongmyo with a good atmosphere 🍷

reviews.author: MIHEE JEONG
reviews.text: It’s a great place to enjoy a unique atmosphere in Dongmyo Alley. There were a lot of classic cocktails to choose from, and they made good recommendations if I told them what I liked, so it was convenient. The 3L mega size cocktail is definitely fun to share. The Detroit pizza and pasta were of good quality, so I was satisfied with my meal and drinks, and it would be even more special if there was a live performance on Saturday. Reservations can be made by phone or Instagram DM.

reviews.text:
A restaurant on the second floor of the building.
It's hard to see from the street, but I applaud the owner for creating a hip place with great snacks and atmosphere.
There are more people than there are tables. It's also crowded with young people.
It is a similar concept to the nearby compass and distillation locomotive.
The table lighting creates a soft atmosphere.
The bathroom is a bit uncomfortable. It is for both men and women. I think it can't be helped because it's narrow. He seems to have affection for the store symbol, Hee-Hoon. The Heehun symbol is engraved on the cup used. Nearby, Mark & ​​Jeon also wrote something similar on their glasses. I think it would be okay to go back to sucking up the energy of young people.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
Pretty good cafe and bar
I went there because I had some time left over from a nearby place, and it was nice.
It's not big, but the atmosphere is nice and it's nice to order a cocktail in the evening, but I had a separate drink plan so I drank coffee. However, I was satisfied because the coffee was better than I expected.
The downside is that you have to climb quite a few stairs.
The staff are also polite and friendly.
But most of the customers seem to be women.
Is it because all the people working there are good-looking?
The accompanying dessert was also delicious.
It's a great place to have a cup of coffee in Sindang or a simple cocktail.

reviews.author: Winnie Lee
reviews.text:
Another great hidden cafe in Sindang Station
It's on the third floor, so be prepared to climb the stairs.
There is a nice view of Shindang Market from the window, and it is convenient to order via QR. Customers are given stickers to write their names on and post them on the wall.
Emotion and taste. perfect place
It's easy to fail at an iced latte, but this one is delicious.
